none.label: No restrictive practice identified
none.notes: A no-RP case has no Interim BSP and no empty RRP scaffolding (MD-012).

possible_unclear.label: Possible or unclear restrictive practice
possible_unclear.notes: Classification review required. No-RP BSP is blocked until resolved.

confirmed.label: Confirmed restrictive practice
confirmed.notes: Interim may open immediately; BSA/FBA continues in parallel.

fba.approved.notes: MD-013. Strategy Instance authoring is locked until the applicable FBA conclusion is approved. Interim safeguards are not Strategy Instances and are not gated by this.

interim.dispositions_complete.requires: every interim safeguard has a disposition of replace | retain_with_new_justification | revise | retire
interim.dispositions_complete.notes: No default. Blocking. Nothing carries quietly.
